name: thread-marketplace
description: Marketplace for the thread plugin: side threads for Claude Code with on-demand hand-back and a kanban board.

plugins.name: thread
plugins.description: Side threads that start from a short brief of the session (or a full copy), report back on demand, and can run as a sub-agent or on another coding CLI through your delegation lanes, plus a project board of tasks, ideas and milestones (summary, kanban, list, your own stages, a done gate) that can wake the session when you answer on it, and open on your phone through a tunnel you turn on.
